## Conclusion

After studying the position of the Arab tribes and the population who settled in the Levant on the Islamic conquest; the study found:

- 1-The Arab tribes and other elements that stood by the fence were apprehensively waiting out of fear for who prevails.
- 3-Jews welcomed Arab conquerors because of the poor relationship with the Roman Empire.
- 2-The Arab tribes that converted to Christianity were not truly Christian and some of whom were forced to fight the Romans in the war. along
- 4-Some cities of the Levant showed resistance to the Islamic conquest; and the most resistant were the northern and coastal ones.
